reflection.assumptions: The pandemic may have influenced patients’ ability to access services, trust health institutions, navigate disruptions in care, and interpret public health messaging in light of prior outbreak experiences.

coding_output:
Initial Code: Patient perceives the seriousness of COVID-19
Clues: "Corona is real and that why the precautions that the government has put in place that the whole world has put in place they said we should abide by them, it real."
Initial Code: Patient doubts effectiveness of healthcare system without traditional remedies
Clues: "People were having this concept that it won’t be treated by the English way unless I go for traditional native medicines that the only it could be treated and that was the concept I was having."
Initial Code: Government lockdown measures impacting daily life
Clues: "It one of the measures that government really put in place like the face mask and all of cause it affected people especially those with asthma diseases the ones with pressure the thing was affecting them."
Initial Code: Transportation issues during lockdown
Clues: "There was no transportation, especially district lockdown transportation was high, and the people with money travels only because if it wasn’t for that, business could have been closed."
Initial Code: School closures affecting educational outcomes
Clues: "When school was closed look at the results that came out because schools closed earlier then second term school was closed so the whole of third term there was no school then we should have closed school the 15th or 25th of July then school closes the 31st of March school did not reopen till August."
Initial Code: Community grumbling about government support during lockdown
Clues: "The day when you say lockdown people that has the chance you see them buying things for their homes and the ones that has no chance you see them sitting down lonely observing and say how, grumbling all over like what is this?"
Initial Code: Challenges of wearing face masks
Clues: "The biggest challenge was this face mask and lockdown because the day when you say lockdown people that has the chance you see them buying things for their homes."
Initial Code: Community self-restriction during pandemic
Clues: "we were not interacting, we were not visiting no one, even when you visit someone he or she will tell you no go to your own house, so that how they were telling us." "yes we restrict ourselves." "the increase in number of death. Of cause the death was low but the number of affected people was increasing so that was making everyone scared..."
Initial Code: Comparison of government responses between Ebola and COVID-19
Clues: "during the time of EBOLA the restriction was there but it was not that much, and for that made people to come here because we had no experience." "as compared to this one before it came government had blocked all the borders and all the districts." "they are able to tackle the situation."
Initial Code: Public fear influenced by rising COVID-19 cases
Clues: "the increase in number of death. Of cause the death was low but the number of affected people was increasing so that was making everyone scared..." "you wouldn’t know who has the sick so if the government said we should sit let us sit..." "the restriction the sensitization was there but during the time of the EBOLA their sensitization was if you are sick you call 117..."
Initial Code: Enhanced government enforcement during COVID-19
Clues: "yes because they enforced it, they enforced the measures, you don’t abide, and they fine a levy on you." "They put it right on every districts to the chiefdoms they involve all the stakeholders..." "the fight was a national fight to the level that it would be but anyway they fight for it."
Initial Code: Community preparedness through past outbreak experience
Clues: "the EBOLA outbreak helped you and your community to prepare for this COVID?" "because they enforced it, they enforced the measures..." "the previous government they have already know although they still don’t have measures but as time goes now they said let put certain restriction in place..."

Clues: "they attack the disease earlier. ... government announces it, so they have given their own measures so we that has the responsibilities we the citizens."
Initial Code: Criticism of healthcare facilities and access
Clues: "initially like they blame them because they were putting centers wherein the position was not there, ... the ones that they put in the camps they were not able to see to them quickly."
Initial Code: Demand for improved healthcare resources
Clues: "government should try to improve on the health centers, more improvement on the health system especially the drugs. ... Let the drugs be available in the hospitals because sometimes when you go to the hospital certain drugs you need in the hospital, unless they refer you to another facility."
Initial Code: Lack of sanitation and infrastructure in hospitals
Clues: "the control measures is poor so they closed them. ... you will go there and if you are not careful you will come out again with another diseases."
Initial Code: Increased costs of medical procedures
Clues: "the time when I did this operation for my hernia in 2015 it costs le 500,000 ... when I went there the woman gave me le 1,200,000 for the same operation."
Initial Code: Perceived care differences between public and private hospitals
Clues: "the nurses in the private hospital are more caring ... unlike for government hospital a lot of noise."
Initial Code: Availability of transportation for healthcare access
Clues: "transportation was available, I went there freely and upon returning I also came freely."
Initial Code: Personal relationship with healthcare providers
Clues: "I will make sure I have a good relation. ... I took his number and we have been communicating day and night."
Initial Code: Patient satisfaction with care during COVID
Clues: "really, really I satisfied with the care, till now and Thursday I should go for checkup because that what the doctor told me."

Clues: "yes because they are pandemic. They already has it so they should put more premium on them but surgical they should also put premium they should care for us because if they do not care where they do the operation it could reoccur so if you are not careful you will die so they should care for us more."

Clues: "when the thing has come from international because we see they provide donor for them, they pour more money on COVID but we never saw donor for operation."

Clues: "because they are giving them extra payments is that not so? The health workers have extra besides what they paid them because if catches you, you have risk your life it would transfer."

Clues: "if there is a vaccine that they will inject a person for him not to have that diseases that what they should be fighting for."
